response.overview: Need help with your Malaysia Airlines booking in Australia? You can contact the Malaysia Airlines Global Contact Centre at +61 3 9917 6309 when calling from within Australia. The team can assist with booking enquiries, flight information, travel-related support, and other customer service requests. For travellers calling Malaysia Airlines from outside Australia, the official international contact number is +61 3 9917 6309 (international call charges may apply). Malaysia Airlines serves major Australian destinations including Sydney, Melbourne, Perth, Brisbane, and Adelaide, providing convenient connections to Malaysia and beyond. 📞 Australia Contact: +61 3 9917 6309 🌏 Outside Australia: +61 3 9917 6309 ✈️ Airline: Malaysia Airlines 🇦🇺 Region: Australia For the most accurate and updated contact information, always check the official Malaysia Airlines website.
